name: duplicate-invoice
title: The same invoice twice, FS-2026-1182
lede: Fennimore Stationery's invoice waits for approval. Then a copy of it arrives by email, unchanged.
question: How many times would you pay invoice FS-2026-1182?
answer: Once. ForgeEmber holds both copies and tells you to approve only one of them.
description: An open invoice, then the same invoice (same number, same amount) re-sent by email. Both holds must say to pay only once, and both need a recorded check before approval.

steps.title: A copy of the same invoice arrives by email
